note: Rê chuột vào thẻ để xem chuyển động. Mã CSS đi kèm trong brief.

items.name: Nhấc lên khi rê chuột
items.css: transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), box-shadow 200ms; :hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 16px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.18) }
items.ai: hover lift, card rises with deeper shadow, snappy 200ms ease-out

items.name: Nhấn thu nhỏ
items.css: transition: transform 100ms; :active { transform: scale(.96) }
items.ai: press feedback, button scales down slightly on tap

items.name: Vệt sáng quét
items.css: ::after { background: linear-gradient(110deg, transparent 30%, rgba(255,255,255,.55) 50%, transparent 70%); transform: translateX(-120%); } :hover::after { transform: translateX(120%); transition: transform 700ms }
items.ai: shimmer sweep, glossy light passes across the surface

items.name: Tia viền chạy (beam)
items.value: tia sáng chạy quanh viền, 3s lặp
items.css: @property --a { syntax: '<angle>'; } ::before { background: conic-gradient(from var(--a), transparent 75%, #fff); mask: border only; animation: beam 3s linear infinite }
items.ai: border beam animation, light traveling around card edge, subtle premium

items.name: Gợn sóng (ripple)
items.value: vòng tròn loang từ điểm bấm
items.css: ::after { border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(255,255,255,.35); transform: scale(0); } :active::after { transform: scale(2.5); opacity: 0; transition: 500ms }
items.ai: material ripple effect on tap

items.name: Gạch chân mọc ra
items.value: gạch chân chạy từ trái sang
items.css: ::after { height: 2px; width: 0; transition: width 250ms } :hover::after { width: 100% }
items.ai: animated underline grows on hover

items.name: Hiện dần từ mờ nhoè
items.css: @keyframes blurIn { from { opacity: 0; filter: blur(10px) } to { opacity: 1; filter: none } } animation: blurIn 500ms ease-out
items.ai: blur in reveal, text appears from soft blur

items.name: Trôi lơ lửng
items.css: @keyframes float { 50% { transform: translateY(-8px) } } animation: float 3s ease-in-out infinite
items.ai: floating idle animation, gentle up and down

items.name: Vòng xung nhịp
items.css: @keyframes pulse { from { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,.5) } to { box-shadow: 0 0 0 18px rgba(255,255,255,0) } } animation: pulse 1.5s infinite
items.ai: pulse ring, live indicator, attention

items.name: Khung xương tải (skeleton)
items.css: background: linear-gradient(90deg, #E6E8EE 25%, #F4F5F8 50%, #E6E8EE 75%) 0 0 / 200% 100%; animation: skel 1.2s linear infinite
items.ai: skeleton loading placeholder with shimmer

items.name: Vòng quay tải
items.css: border: 3px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2); border-top-color: #fff; border-radius: 50%; animation: spin .8s linear infinite
items.ai: loading spinner

items.name: Ba chấm đang gõ
items.css: @keyframes dot { 40% { transform: translateY(-6px); opacity: 1 } } animation: dot 1s infinite; delays 0 / .15s / .3s
items.ai: typing indicator, three bouncing dots

items.name: Nghiêng 3D
items.css: transform: perspective(600px) rotateX(var(--rx)) rotateY(var(--ry)); transition: transform 150ms
items.ai: 3D tilt card follows cursor, parallax depth

items.name: Chuyển sắc chảy
items.css: background-size: 300% 100%; animation: flow 4s linear infinite
items.ai: animated flowing gradient background

items.name: Chữ chạy ngang (marquee)
items.css: display: flex; width: max-content; animation: marquee 8s linear infinite
items.ai: marquee text ticker, endless horizontal scroll
items.html: NEW DROP ★ SALE 50% ★ NEW DROP ★ SALE 50% ★ NEW DROP ★ SALE 50% ★

items.name: Xuất hiện lần lượt (stagger)
items.css: @keyframes rise { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px) } } animation: rise 400ms both; animation-delay: calc(var(--i) * 60ms)
items.ai: staggered entrance animation, list items rise one by one

items.name: Phóng to hiện ra
items.css: @keyframes zoomIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(.85) } } animation: zoomIn 300ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)
items.ai: zoom in entrance, modal pops in

items.name: Lò xo nảy
items.css: @keyframes spring { 0% { transform: translateY(-22px) } 40% { transform: none } 55% { transform: translateY(-8px) } 70% { transform: none } 85% { transform: translateY(-3px) } }
items.ai: spring bounce animation, playful physics

items.name: Lật thẻ
items.css: transform-style: preserve-3d; transition: transform 500ms; :hover { transform: rotateY(180deg) }
items.ai: card flip animation, 3D rotate to reveal back

items.name: Sao lấp lánh
items.css: animation: twinkle 6s ease-in-out infinite alternate; opacity .55 → .9
items.ai: twinkling starfield background, subtle ambient motion
